messages.subject: shiny.js API (or something similar)?
parts:
Hi,
I've created a few shiny web apps, but without any javascript/html code.  I've decided to learn javascript so I can bind javascript and shiny together and make more feature rich web apps.  Looking over javascript files associated with shiny web apps, I've come across quite a number of shiny.js methods, but no description of what they do/how to use them/when to use then.  For example, some methods I've come across include: Shiny.bindAll(), Shiny.unbindAll(), Shiny.onInputChange(), Shiny.addCustomMessageHandler(), etc. I know that the shiny tutorial discuss some (Shiny.InputBinding(), Shiny.inputBindings.register(), for example), but is there a shiny.js API guide that explains these different methods, or are these standard javascript methods, or am I missing something?

Thanks in advance!

messages.author: ca443e6eaa0e78ed
messages.subject: Re: shiny.js API (or something similar)?
parts:
We don't have official docs for this stuff today, I have been a little ambivalent about whether these are even officially supported APIs but I think that ship has probably sailed.

Here's an explanation of onInputChange and addCustomMessageHandler, I just skimmed but it appears to be accurate:
http://ryouready.wordpress.com/2013/11/20/sending-data-from-client-to-server-and-back-using-shiny/

Oh actually bindAll/unbindAll are documented at the bottom of this article:
http://shiny.rstudio.com/articles/dynamic-ui.html
